headline: EU Considers Broadening China Import Curbs Beyond Electric Vehicles
summary: European ministers are weighing import restraints across additional industrial sectors in talks with Beijing as the EU seeks to curb its expanding bilateral trade deficit.
why: Trade tensions between the European Union and China carry significant implications for global manufacturing supply chains and tariff barriers.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Broader European trade restrictions threaten Chinese export volumes across key manufacturing industries.
